title: Lecturer on Law
bio: Peter Grossi is a retired partner at Arnold & Porter and a former chair of the firm’s Litigation Department. For the last 40 years he has represented pharmaceutical companies and other industries, as both trial and national coordinating counsel, in cases throughout the country. He has repeatedly been named as the “Senior Statesman” of the […]
